notes.title: Just One More Review to Go! 🐟
notes.content:
Adventurers of the deep, we need you! ⚓

A heartfelt thank you to every brave soul who has taken the plunge into the waters of AquaDream! 💙 We're now only [b]ONE[/b] review away from reaching the important 10-review milestone on Steam!

If you've explored the ocean depths and enjoyed your time with our anglerfish friend, your review could truly make a difference. A quick comment can help other dreamers discover the world of AquaDream — and boost our visibility to keep growing this cozy underwater journey.

Be the hero who lights up the abyss. Leave a review today and help us reach the next level! 🐚

notes.title: AquaDream is OUT NOW! 🌊
notes.content:
Embark on a soothing underwater adventure today! 

A huge thank you to everyone who followed us on this journey — we’re thrilled to announce that AquaDream is now officially released on Steam! 💙

In this cozy underwater puzzle game, you’ll guide a glowing anglerfish through mysterious ruins, shifting currents, ancient traps, and shimmering beaches. Relaxing but full of surprises, AquaDream is the perfect escape into the deep.

🎮 Controller and keyboard supported
🌎 30 handcrafted levels across 4 unique worlds
🐚 Secrets, collectibles and more !

💬 Already played the demo? Now’s the time to dive back in and explore the full experience!

👉 Don’t forget to leave a review if you enjoy your time in the deep — it really helps indie devs like us!

notes.title: AquaDream New Trailer & Release Date!
notes.content:
[h2]Hello everyone,[/h2]

We are thrilled to finally share some exciting news with you all — the new AquaDream trailer is here, and we’ve also locked in our official release date! Get ready to dive deeper into the underwater world of AquaDream, because the game will be launching on [b]May 22th, 2025[/b]!

It’s been an incredible journey bringing AquaDream to life, and we want to thank each and every one of you for your support, feedback, and patience throughout development. The game has evolved a lot since the early demo, and we’re so proud of how it’s shaping up. From the gameplay mechanics to the visuals and story, everything has been refined and enhanced based on your valuable input.

[h3]What’s New[/h3]
The new trailer highlights the improvements and enhancements we’ve made since the first preview, showcasing:
[list]

[*] Refined visuals that bring the underwater environments to life with greater detail, from lush coral reefs to eerie, ancient ruins.

[*] Polished gameplay mechanics that make puzzle-solving and exploration feel smoother and more immersive.
[/list]

[previewyoutube=vjameuQZ328;full][/previewyoutube]

[h3]Thank You for Your Support![/h3]
We’re incredibly grateful for the community that’s built around AquaDream. Your feedback has been instrumental in shaping the game into what it is today. Whether you’ve been following us since the early days or just recently joined us, we want you to know how much your enthusiasm and support mean to us.

[h3]What’s Next?[/h3]
As we countdown to May 22th, we’ll be sharing more updates, behind-the-scenes looks at development, and some exciting previews. Make sure to wishlist AquaDream on Steam to get notifications about the release, and don’t forget to follow us on social media for the latest news!

[h3]Price & Discounts:[/h3]
We’re also excited to announce the pricing details for AquaDream’s launch:

AquaDream will be available for [b]$4.99 USD[/b] at launch, with a [b]15% off[/b] discount for the first 14 days.

The Original Soundtrack (OST) will be available for [b]$0.99 USD[/b], also with a [b]15% off[/b] discount for the first 14 days.

There will be a bundle that includes both the game and the OST, which will be available at a 5% off discount for all time. During the first 14 days, the total discount for the bundle will be [b]20% off[/b]!

We hope these special offers make your experience with AquaDream even more exciting!

Once again, thank you so much for your support. AquaDream is closer than ever to being ready for release, and we can’t wait for you to experience the full journey!

See you underwater on [b]May 22th, 2025[/b]!

[i]Gossiam Games[/i]

notes.title: AquaDream Demo Removal
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

We wanted to inform you that the AquaDream demo will be removed on [b]April 30th[/b], as it is no longer representative of the final product. The demo was originally created to introduce AquaDream during Steam Next Fest, and since then, we've made significant progress. There were still a few issues in the demo that we’ve since fixed, and it no longer reflects the current state of the game.

We are incredibly grateful to each and every one of you who took the time to play the demo, explore the world of AquaDream, and provide valuable feedback. Your support has helped us improve the game, and we appreciate the time you’ve invested in playing it!

But don’t worry — a brand-new trailer, showcasing the latest version of AquaDream, will be arriving soon. Along with it, we’ll be revealing the official release date, so stay tuned for some exciting news!

Thank you once again for your support — we can’t wait to share more with you as we move closer to the final release!

[i]Gossiam Games[/i]

notes.title: AquaDream Demo Drops January 31 at Midnight!
notes.content:
Hey everyone!

I’m thrilled to share that the AquaDream demo is going live on Friday, January 31, at midnight! 🎉

The demo includes the first 6 levels, offering [b]20-30 minutes[/b] of gameplay to dive into. It’s a great chance to explore the underwater world, solve puzzles, and get a feel for the game! Plus, this demo is a big step in preparing for the February Steam Next Fest, which I’m so excited to be a part of!

Thank you so much for your incredible support—it means the world to me! 💙

Stay tuned, and I can’t wait for you to experience AquaDream[img]

notes.title: AquaDream Demo Coming Soon!
notes.content:
We’re thrilled to announce that the demo for AquaDream, our cozy underwater puzzle adventure, is coming very soon—late December to early January! 🐟

You’ll soon get the chance to step into the fins of our anglerfish hero, navigating mysterious underwater worlds, solving intricate puzzles, and uncovering the secrets of the deep. Whether it’s collecting shells, avoiding traps, or exploring ocean currents, the demo will offer a glimpse of the full AquaDream experience.

Mark your calendars, [b]wishlist AquaDream[/b], and keep an eye out for the exact release date!


[i]Before I go, I just want to say thank you from the bottom of my heart. Working on AquaDream has been such an incredible journey, and knowing that so many of you are excited to play it keeps me motivated every day. I can’t wait for you to try the demo and hear what you think! You’re the reason I can make this dream a reality—thank you for being part of it. 💙[/i]
